verses.1: Do not worship the LORD your God with idols. For all evil things will come from those idols. For it is a violation of the LORD your God’s commandment.
verses.2: For there may be found among your gates a man or woman who will do what is evil in the eyes of Jehovah your God, thereby breaking his covenant with you.
verses.3: And he went and served other gods. He bowed down to them, as well as to the sun, to the moon, and to all the heavenly beings who were not commanded by me.
verses.4: And I will show you what you have heard and understood well. Now, truth will be fulfilled; this oppression will be ended in Israel.
verses.5: And you shall take out that man or woman who has done this evil against your gates. You shall stone them to death.
verses.6: According to two or three witnesses, if a person dies, he does not die because of just one witness.
verses.7: The hand of the witnesses shall be used first to kill him. Then, the hand of all the people shall be used to bring about his destruction from your presence.
verses.8: For a decision will be made among you regarding blood, between blood and blood, between disputes and disputes. And in your streets, there will be words of strife. But you shall stand up and go to the place that Jehovah your God chooses.
verses.9: And you shall go before the priests, the Levites, and before the judges who would be in charge during those days. Then they will tell you what the judgment will be.
verses.10: And you shall do according to what they will tell you from that place where Jehovah has chosen it. And you shall keep doing everything that they command you to do.
verses.11: According to the Torah that you have received, and according to the laws that were given to you, do not reject anything that is said to you. Do not ignore what is written in the Torah.
verses.12: And the man who acts in a corrupt manner, so that he does not listen to the priest who stands there to serve your God, or to those who judge. When such a man dies, he will be buried in the land of Israel.
verses.13: And all the people shall hear and see, and they will not rebel again.
verses.14: For when you enter the land that Jehovah your God gives you, and you take possession of it and settle down in it, then you shall say to yourself, “I will humble the king of all the nations around me.”
verses.15: May there be a king over you, one whom Jehovah your God will choose from among your brothers. May he be the king over you. You must not give any foreigner who is not your brother to be king over you.
verses.16: Let them not be filled with horses, and let they not bring the people back from Egypt. For they will multiply their horses. And God said to you: “Do not go back along this path again.”
verses.17: And women shall not become excessive in his favor, nor shall their hearts be filled with greed. Nor shall he accumulate too much gold and silver.
verses.18: And when he sat on his throne as king, he wrote down this new law on a scroll before the holy priests.
verses.19: And he would be with him, and he would call upon him every day of his life, so that he could learn to honor Jehovah, his God. He would also keep all the laws and commands mentioned in the Torah.
verses.20: I will not let his heart be separated from his brothers. Nor will I break the commandments of God. May he and his sons be remembered forever among the people of Israel.
